SELECT COALESCE(SITE, '<SQL NULL>') AS site_value,
       DATE_TRUNC('week', EVENT_TS)::DATE AS week_start,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT EVENT_NAME) AS distinct_event_names,
       MAX(EVENT_SOURCE) AS sample_source
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.FACT_EVENTS
WHERE EVENT_TS >= '2026-06-01'
  AND (SITE IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(SITE)) IN ('null', 'undefined', ''))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT PRODUCT,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PATIENT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_without_patient,
       MIN(EVENT_TS)::DATE AS first_seen,
       MAX(EVENT_TS)::DATE AS last_seen
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.FACT_EVENTS
WHERE EVENT_TS >= DATEADD('day', -14, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND SITE IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME
FROM ANALYTICS.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%FACILIT%'
ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

SELECT KEY, COUNT(*) AS rows_ct, COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT) AS patients
FROM ANALYTICS.BASE_NON_PHI.PATIENTDATA
WHERE LOWER(ENV) = 'intermountain'
GROUP BY KEY
ORDER BY rows_ct DESC

SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
FROM ANALYTICS.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'DWH'
  AND (
    (TABLE_NAME = 'DIM_PATIENT' AND (COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%PATIENT_ID%' OR COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%ENV%' OR COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%SITE%' OR COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%LANGUAGE%' OR COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%FACILIT%'))
    OR TABLE_NAME IN ('DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY', 'DIM_FACILITY')
  )
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT PREFERRED_LANGUAGE, COUNT(*) AS patients
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total, COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS distinct_patients
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT
WHERE LOWER(ENV) = 'intermountain'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS patients_with_facility,
       COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID) AS distinct_facilities,
       SUM(CASE WHEN _SNOWFLAKE_DELETED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN RN_LATEST = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rn_latest_rows,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID), 0), 2) AS avg_facilities_per_patient
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY
WHERE LOWER(ENV) = 'intermountain'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS facilities,
       SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ACTIVE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active,
       SUM(CASE WHEN FACILITY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unnamed
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_FACILITY
WHERE LOWER(ENV) = 'intermountain'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.FACILITY_ID_COUNT, 0) = COALESCE(b.ct, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agreeing_patients,
  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.FACILITY_ID_COUNT, 0) <> COALESCE(b.ct, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverging_patients
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT dp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ENV, PATIENT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID) AS ct
  FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY
  WHERE NOT _SNOWFLAKE_DELETED
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) b ON b.ENV = dp.ENV AND b.PATIENT_ID = dp.PATIENT_ID
WHERE LOWER(dp.ENV) = 'intermountain'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS merged_pointer_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN FACILITY_ID_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS merged_with_facility
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT
WHERE LOWER(ENV) = 'intermountain'
  AND MERGED_INTO_PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL

WITH rn_check AS (
  SELECT ENV, PATIENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS rn1_rows
  FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY
  WHERE RN_LATEST = 1 AND NOT _SNOWFLAKE_DELETED
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rn_check WHERE rn1_rows > 1) AS patients_with_rn1_ties,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ENV) FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT WHERE ENV != LOWER(ENV)) AS dim_patient_envs_not_lowercase,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ENV) FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY WHERE ENV != LOWER(ENV)) AS bridge_envs_not_lowercase,
  (SELECT MAX(DWH_UPDATED_AT) FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT) AS dim_patient_freshness,
  (SELECT MAX(DWH_UPDATED_AT) FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.DIM_PATIENT_FACILITY) AS bridge_freshness
